notes.title: December 2022 Update
notes.content: For the 2022 December update, new visual biomes were added and post processing was improved.

notes.title: Summer Sale Update : 2022
notes.content: Added more variety to the world flora.  Cleaned up some of the visuals.  We are working on our next game, but will continue to provide updates to Lux.

notes.title: Hotfix for update
notes.content: quick hotfilx

notes.title: Dec 2021 Update hotfix
notes.content: Hotfix for collision system.

notes.title: December Update - bugfix
notes.content: -Fixed a bug that would cause some players to become stuck while climbing the final tower.

notes.title: Decorative Touches - mini update
notes.content:
- Added some more distant objects to make taking photos more interesting. 
- Capturing realities (the photo mini game) now also increases your ability to extract fossils while digging.
- Fixed a bug that could prevent the final conversation from triggering

notes.title: Biome Update - December 2021
notes.content: Our new Biome Variety update is nearly complete.  New world randomization and various improvements to the UI.

notes.title: Winter Sale Update
notes.content:
In preparation for the winter sale, pushed out a bigger update than usual!

-Fixed various button explanations
-Improved aesthetic of various menus
-Prevented exit from important messages until completed
-Fixed a bug with the photo mode (Reality capture)
-Updated the tips that appear from time to time with updates info
-added a warning to let you know when you leave the safety range of the house
-the tiny lamps no longer have collision, preventing some odd behavior
-Recipes cleaned up to be easier to understand
-The Well increases your max life force from a much greater range than before.

notes.title: Reality Capture Update! November 2021
notes.content:
For November we rolled out the Reality Capture mechanic!  Press T to capture images and data about your current reality!  Press V to view images you have captured.  To Restore the tower, you must gather at least 10 data captures from different realities.  

Fixes : 
Tutorial revamped to prevent house placement from looking out of place.  
Menus further cleaned up and missing tool tips corrected.
The new T and V keys are listed on the control screens (Press Y to toggle menus)
Digging graphic improved to be more visually accurate and smoother.
Slight performance improvements.

notes.title: Controller Patch for New Menu System Update
notes.content: The latest update caused some issues with controller support.  Most, if not all, have been found.

notes.title: Lands Variety : November 2021 Update
notes.content: Added in a dozen or so new land types that can appear as you wander the multiverse.  New Lower Price, and various menu improvements.

notes.title: New Menus and Message Patch
notes.content:
Made it more obvious the player is getting a message that they should read.
Cleaned up some of the new menus to be a little more organized by topics.

notes.title: Simplified Menu Patch - part 2
notes.content:
Added some more functionality to the menus and gave them a little more life.

-fixed an incorrectly labeled button

notes.title: Easy Menu Update - quick fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the new menu that prevented scrolling through the history cubes.

notes.title: Simplified Menu System Update
notes.content: Simplified the menu system.  All of the menus are now accessible from every menu.

notes.title: Misbehaving Tree Patch
notes.content: One of the trees was refusing to wear foliage on its head.  We've had a stern talking to, and we think it will start behaving. Probably.

notes.title: New Menu System : Pre-Halloween 2021 Patch
notes.content:
-New Menu System
Consolidated the various menus so that they all link to each other via a series of buttons.

notes.title: Quick Fix
notes.content: Fixed a change from the last patch that caused the controller button B to stop opening the inventory, forcing the player to use the keyboard shortcut, i.

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements - October 2021 Patch
notes.content:
-Corrected several menu errors
-Fixed an issue that could cause you to see through the world while spamming jump
-Various UI visual improvements - bigger buttons, etc.
-Objectives of game clearly spelled out in Journal Page
-Fixed a bug that would give you the compass without purchasing it
-clarified placement mode must be on to place items
-fixed an issue that could prevent someone from collecting the rarer fossil types

notes.title: Additional Placeables, World variety tweaks, some bugfixes
notes.content:
Added more place-ables to the unlockables

Created more variety in the randomization of zones.

Fixed a bug that allowed you to gain unlockables without paying for them.

notes.title: NEW Placeables! + quick fix completed
notes.content:
fixed an issue with vr menus showing up during non-vr game play.

Added the first batch of a bunch of new items to place in your world.

Unlock more items to place in your Skill Book!

notes.title: Spanish Language Patch - part 2
notes.content:
More menus and gameplay screens translated to the spanish language. (Check the box in the main settings screen to change your language to spanish).

Fixed an issue with the start button on the controller causing the player to fall through the world from certain locations.

notes.title: Small updates & bugfixes
notes.content:
- Fixed people jumping behind the first statue at the start of the game.
- General improvements to UI and color schemes.

notes.title: VR BETA update for 7/10/21
notes.content:
The VR Beta branch is active.  We look forward to hearing feedback from those with PC VR Headsets.  It requires a controller and is a seated experience.  Skills were updated and some minor fixes were applied for the Skills Update. 

We plan on testing on Quest 2 VR headsets (wired & Wireless connection to PC) in the coming days.

notes.title: Bloom patch
notes.content: -Added a bloom slider to the settings menu, allowing you to control the visual intensity.

notes.title: Placement Improvement Patch
notes.content:
The placement system has gotten a revamp.  You are able to see all the controls
while in the placement mode.  Objects should be easier to place and move around.

notes.title: more bugfixes
notes.content: Fixed a few bugs introduced by the new update.

notes.title: hotfix
notes.content: hotfix

notes.title: UI Improvements for the new update
notes.content: Some visual improvements for the new UI to more match the game's theme.

notes.title: More Bugfixes for Update
notes.content: More bugfixes related to the newest Reality Creation update.

notes.title: Reality Creation update - Complete
notes.content:
Our multi part update is now complete.  This update aimed to add more things to the world and more things to do.  

*Crystals 
The deepest block type can be spent in many new ways.  Some enhance your character, and some enhance your ability to alter the look of the world.  Look at your skill book pages to explore them!

*New enemy type 
The Dark Matter can only be stopped by trapping it in a light box (a new unlockable placement item).

*Visual improvements and additions, new mountains are settled in.

*Many UI enhancements, to help make the UI more usable.

notes.title: Dark Matter & Placing Patch
notes.content:
-New feature - Press X to remove all your placed items at once.

Dark Matter and other Fixes
-The new enemies were a little too excited to be included and were appearing too often.
-They now also give clearer signals for hunting the player and their other actions.
-Fixed a bug that prevented knowledge cubes from showing their text
-Fixed a bug that did not record the amount of flight time skill purchased.

notes.title: Dark Sphere Enemy?! Update
notes.content: While traveling the world, the Dark Spheres that drove your people out of this world will pursue you.  Although you were created to withstand their full assault, they will come after your lucky crystals.  If you have more than 50 crystals (The deepest block types all give a crystal), the Dark Sphere will help themselves to some before dissipating.

notes.title: Quick Visual Patch
notes.content: Cleaned up some of the visuals.

notes.title: Skills Update Part 2
notes.content:
The first half of the skills page is now complete.  New skills to teleport the player to the Tower, increase jumps, flight, and more are now available.

-Added button to quickly prepare the last item you crafted.
-some bugfixes to the Skill System.

notes.title: hotfix
notes.content: Hotfix for new skill system.

notes.title: Skills Update 06/15/21
notes.content:
We created a new skill system to add more gameplay options.  You can now use your excess crystals to increase your max health, learn new placement items, or further empower your staves.  More skills are being worked on and will be added in the coming days.  

-cleaned up and changed some of the visuals to better fit the theme & story of the game.

notes.title: Patch notes for 06/12/21
notes.content: Added more reality biome options, Sky-Water & Fire-Grass.  Cleaned up the Tutorial further.

notes.title: 06/11 patch Part 2
notes.content:
Fixed the intro to be better explained and simpler to complete.
Separated placement mode into categories to allow faster access in the future.

notes.title: patch for 06/11/21
notes.content:
Just a few minor fixes for yesterday's Tutorial patch & a small addition.
-Change : You now dig faster while near your house.

notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.content: When you start a new game, the story is now tied into a small tutorial to help players get acquainted with the main gameplay.  Players learn to place their house, excavate the statues, craft materials, and use placement mode before being set free.

notes.title: minor update for 6/10/21
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue with the main menu that caused the mouse to misbehave
-Updated Tutorial to auto-play
-The H tutorial is accessible in the Info Vault.
-Doubled the home safe range

notes.title: Placement System Update
notes.content:
Added some new items to the placement system and new functionality.

Use V and F to resize the item you are trying to place!
The item now follows the cursor, allowing for faster placement.
Updated controls screen to reflect new functionality.

notes.title: Update notes for 6/9/2021
notes.content:
New Feature
Record data from realities you visit. The data creates Magic Bags, which are used in some of the tougher recipes.

-cleaned up the Spanish translation a bit.

notes.title: Update notes for 6/8/21
notes.content: A small patch to put in the story Spanish translation.  In settings, click the checkbox before you begin a game to experience the game's main story in the Spanish language.
